sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme aims to impart vocational education alongside academic learning to students of classes 9 to 12 in selected government secondary schools. Vocational education is offered in 08 sectors approved by the Government of India under the NSQF framework.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning; Sector: Voctional education

**Detailed Description:** The “Vocational Education Programme” is a scheme under the Samagra Shiksha Programme, implemented by the Secondary Education Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to impart vocational education alongside academic learning to students of classes 9 to 12 in selected government secondary schools.

**Benefits / Assistance:** Under the programme, 08 sectors approved by the Government of India are being implemented under NSQF to provide vocational education alongside academic education for students of classes 9 to 12 in selected schools, where they receive both vocational education and training.

**Application Process:** - All students studying in classes 9 to 12 in government secondary schools where vocational education is conducted can take admission in the sectors operated under this programme. - If a student from another school wishes to study the vocational education curriculum, they must take admission in a school where the vocational education curriculum is being conducted. - Students already studying in such schools can choose vocational education as one of their subjects like other subjects. For this, no separate application is required. - There is also no need to submit any documents for the selection of vocational education subject.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Secondary Education Department, Government Of Uttarakhand; Nodal Department: Department Of Education
**Tags:** Vocational Education, Skill Development, Training, Student, Government Secondary Schools
